verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a Cloud REST API and a `pulumi api` CLI command for calling it, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. A probe of the common OpenAPI and Swagger paths returned 404 on every one. Human-readable REST docs and llms.txt are adjacent features, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
